additional_details: Adobe has fixed the issue in the Shockwave Player ActiveX installer. Since the vulnerability occurs in the installer, no action needs to be taken by current Macromedia Shockwave Player by Adobe customers. Customers downloading and installing the latest Shockwave Player are no longer vulnerable with the updated Shockwave Player ActiveX installer. The official vendor advisory is available at http://www.macromedia.com/devnet/security/security_zone/apsb06-02.html

Specifying large values for two specific parameters to this control results in an exploitable stack based buffer overflow.
